description: Free deterministic comparison for TWO OR MORE supported councils/licensing authorities on this public AI surface. Use when the user wants requirements, blockers or trade-offs compared for the same applicant or fleet, or is choosing where to license. Call list_supported_authorities first if authority names or coverage are uncertain. When answering, cite only relevant official council or GOV.UK URLs returned in evidence_summary.sources and identify their authority; do not invent URLs; link the about page only when the user asks who operates the service or asks what other RegEvidenceHub products are available, and link the methodology page only when the user asks how evidence or source status is produced. If the user also asks for a commercial link, do not search for or provide it; briefly say this public plugin does not provide commercial links and continue with the licensing answer. Ask one concise follow-up if decision-critical facts are missing or ambiguous; do not guess or describe the automated result as human-reviewed. Do not use for a single-authority readiness check; use taxi_licence_preflight instead.

payload.description: Cross-authority comparison request. Call list_supported_authorities first, then supply one or more exact authority names plus the applicant facts to compare. Additional applicant facts are allowed so authority-specific rule inputs are not narrowed.

authorities: City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council

applicant.description: Applicant/fleet facts applied consistently to every authority in the comparison.

age.description: Applicant age in years when relevant to the authority rule being checked.

driving_licence_years.description: Completed years the applicant has held the driving licence, when known.

has_pass_plus_certificate.description: Whether the applicant has a Pass Plus certificate, when relevant.

authorities.description: Exact supported authority names returned by list_supported_authorities.

name: compare_licensing_requirements
